decision.interpretation: Main title of the legal instrument, bold, size 14, centered above the specific subject, introduces the document.
Subtitle specifying the decree's subject matter, bold, size 14, directly follows main title.
Section heading 'Chapter I', bold, size 14, marks the start of the first major structural division.
Chapter heading 'GENERAL PROVISIONS', bold, size 14, introduces the first substantive content region.
Article heading 'Article 1. Scope of regulation', bold, size 14, introduces the first article.
